title: Detailed watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M38 32 Q38 18 52 18 Q66 18 66 32' fill='none' stroke='#5ec8ff' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 32 Q38 18 52 18 Q66 18 66 32' fill='none' stroke='#a8e8ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='34' y='36' width='36' height='40' rx='7' fill='#4fa8dd'/>
  <rect x='36' y='38' width='32' height='36' rx='6' fill='#66c2f0'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='40' y='42' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#a8e8ff'/>
  <!-- top rim -->
  <rect x='32' y='33' width='40' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#8fd8ff'/>
  <rect x='34' y='34' width='36' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#c8f0ff'/>
  <!-- bottom band -->
  <rect x='34' y='69' width='36' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#3b8bbc'/>
  <rect x='36' y='70' width='32' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5ec8ff'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M34 52 L12 34 L18 28 L40 48 Z' fill='#4fa8dd'/>
  <path d='M34 52 L12 34 L18 28 L40 48 Z' fill='none' stroke='#8fd8ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- spout highlight -->
  <path d='M33 48 L18 36 L21 33 L36 45 Z' fill='#a8e8ff'/>
  <!-- rose / sprinkler head -->
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='29' rx='9' ry='6' transform='rotate(-40 12 29)' fill='#f2c94c'/>
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='29' rx='6' ry='4' transform='rotate(-40 12 29)' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <!-- sprinkler holes -->
  <circle cx='10' cy='26' r='1' fill='#d89a1e'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='27' r='1' fill='#d89a1e'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='29' r='1' fill='#d89a1e'/>
  <circle cx='9' cy='31' r='1' fill='#d89a1e'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='32' r='1' fill='#d89a1e'/>
  <!-- water drops from spout -->
  <circle cx='6' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#5ec8ff'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='19' r='1.5' fill='#5ec8ff'/>
  <circle cx='4' cy='17' r='1.2' fill='#8fd8ff'/>
  <!-- decorative flower on body -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='54' r='6' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='54' r='3' fill='#f2c94c'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='54' r='2' fill='#ff8fc8'/>
</svg>
